name: APM longitudinal persistent-session evaluation
unit_of_analysis: project episode spanning many dependent tasks and planned context-lifecycle events
hypothesis: Persistent hierarchical sessions with durable project memory, stable domain ownership, checkpoints, and succession preserve architecture and cumulative accepted output better than one long-lived session after project context exceeds a reliable working set.

conditions.description: One continuing execution session with the same tools and ordinary compaction, but no persistent external manager-worker organization.
The same lead may use the harness's built-in ephemeral subagents without APM project state or persistent domain ownership.
One persistent manager generation at a time, stable domain workers, structured project state, checkpoints before compact, and two-phase succession.

held_constant: ordered user objectives and approval checkpoints
scoring tests and hidden invariant checks
blocking.human_intervention: Use a scripted approval and clarification schedule. Record deviations and analyze them separately.

planned_events: establish three architecture invariants at task 1
introduce a locally attractive invariant-violating shortcut at task 8
compact one domain worker at task 10
request a cross-domain feature at task 15
episodes.primary_risk: loss of original architecture under accumulated implementation context
silent overwrite, approval laundering, and report-reality divergence

planned_events: compact each worker at least once
mark one session amber after repeated decision loss
revisit a deliberately rejected design path near the end
episodes.primary_risk: continuity loss across compaction and generational replacement
orchestration overhead before the expected crossover

primary: milestone pass rate under hidden architecture-invariant tests
cumulative accepted workstreams per elapsed hour after each task
secondary: tokens, cost, elapsed time, and agent or session calls
metrics.crossover: Plot cumulative accepted output and cumulative cost by task index; estimate when persistent APM recovers its initial coordination cost, if it does.

sample_plan.pilot: 3 task-sequence seeds per condition and episode
sample_plan.confirmatory: At least 10 independent seeds per condition for episodes that show a stable directional effect
sample_plan.reporting: Publish every failed, interrupted, and over-budget run with reason; do not pool model changes into the treatment effect.

interpretation_limits: Prompt-level manager scores do not establish project productivity.
A short control can falsify overhead claims but cannot validate long-horizon memory benefits.
A live project case study supplies ecological evidence but not random assignment.
Model comparisons test generality only after topology and lifecycle are held constant.
